_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Leg is flat in a coil; F&G near the Complacency ceiling with only mild 30d drift and no fresh breaker, so HOLD is the graded base-rate call until flows or funding resolve.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly HOLD toward Complacency; narrative supplies flow color but no opposing forward phase, so no hard split on direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, Fear & Greed holds 47-54, funding near flat, and ETF flows do not deteriorate further
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks below 46 on a funding flush with ETF flows near zero, or pushes above 62 with ETF flows turning clearly positive
